description:
## Goal

Build the new Dashboard page that replaces the Settings tab in the main navigation. Move Settings to a gear icon in the header. The Dashboard becomes the strategic overview for initiative management and daily prioritization.

## Implementation

### Settings Relocation
- Remove Settings from the 5-tab navigation in `MainLayout.tsx`
- Add a gear icon button in the desktop header (right side, near the agents-running dropdown)
- Gear icon opens a dialog or slide-over panel containing the existing SettingsPage content
- On mobile: gear icon in the header bar
- All settings functionality preserved — just relocated from a tab to an overlay

### Dashboard Tab
- Replace the Settings tab with Dashboard (first tab position for quick access, or keep current ordering)
- Icon: LayoutDashboard from lucide-react
- Path: `/dashboard`
- Keyboard shortcut: reassign appropriately

### Snapshot Stats Bar (top section)
- Single horizontal row of clickable stat cards
- Stats: Active Items | In Progress | Blocked | Ready to Go | Completed
- Each stat links to the backlog page with appropriate filter applied
- Compact design — should not require scrolling on any device

### Initiative Cards (main section)
- Scrollable grid of initiative cards, responsive (1 column mobile, 2-3 columns desktop)
- Each card displays:
  - Title + priority badge
  - Progress bar with completion ratio (e.g., "2/9 complete")
  - Status breakdown with colored dots (ready, in progress, blocked)
  - "Next up" — highest-priority unblocked item name
  - Blocked summary — what's blocking or "all clear"
  - Quick actions: "View Items" (navigates to `/backlog?initiative=X`), "Run Next" (queues next unblocked)
- Cards sorted by initiative priority, then by completion percentage (ascending)
- "Unassigned" count at the bottom if items exist without an initiative

### Needs Attention Feed (bottom section)
- Compact list of items needing human action (from the new attention endpoint)
- Each entry: icon (warning/bell/hand) + item reference + reason
- Clickable — navigates to the relevant backlog detail page
- Collapsible if empty ("Nothing needs attention" message)

### Empty State
- If no initiatives exist, show a friendly prompt to create one with a link to the meta-orchestrator workflow

## Key Files

- Layout: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/components/layout/MainLayout.tsx`
- Settings page: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`
- App routes: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/App.tsx`
- Initiative types: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/types/domain.ts`
- Backlog service: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/services/backlog-service.ts`
- Existing initiative badge: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/components/backlog/initiative-badge.tsx`
